contract.authority: HirBenchExecutionTarget is the sole stable semantic and wire value. ScriptBench and CLI report retain it directly; no mirrored DTO or command-name/prefix classifier.
contract.identity: DeclarationName owns validated registry identity; Syntax owns the exact NameReference node/range. HIR lowering enforces existing NameBytes admission before allocating the registry name.
contract.source: HIR source freeze re-derives default/named target from the attached owner and rejects target substitution atomically before publication.
contract.codec: Headless is an explicit zero-field record variant. Mandatory target, strict unknown fields/tags, and validated names; no legacy missing-target default reader. No HIR session, scope, expression or frame identity is serialized.
contract.dependency: Move existing HIR serde dependency from dev to production solely for this stable leaf; preserve layer direction and Sans I/O. Fresh all-feature metadata and canonical dependency gate verify the change.
contract.execution: The headless bench runner owns no named adapter executor. Valid named-target sections return Skipped with no timing/helper measurement.
